risk.rationale: Case-006 (b.cetin@aegean.edu) has a single verified finding: F1 [LIKELY 0.6] sign-in from previously unseen device PH-9900 versus usual device LT-6002 ({T1078}). The two password-spray-then-success claims are rejected with strong justification — both IPs (78.187.4.44 and 193.140.10.17) are shared egress points with 186 and 208 distinct MFA-completing accounts respectively over 30 days (far above the threshold of 10), so the failures are background noise, not coordinated sprays. There are no data-quality conflicts. The remaining signal is isolated, moderate-confidence (0.6), and uncorroborated: insufficient for a confirmed account-takeover chain (contain), not explained away (benign), and not conflicting or insufficient enough to require human escalation. It is a weak unexplained signal consistent with monitor.
